# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-013A1 - GitHub Sync Automation and Poller Lifecycle

**Purpose**: Validate data-integrity requirement quality for success-only cursor advancement, durable partial-run state, shared-repository owner filtering, lifecycle schema idempotence, indexes, and rollback documentation.
**Created**: 2026-05-23
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are failed-sync cursor preservation requirements explicitly defined for automatic attempts and retry visibility? [Completeness, Spec FR-014, Spec SC-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are success-only cursor advancement requirements defined so a cursor advances only after a bounded outcome that is safe to resume from? [Completeness, Spec FR-015, Data Model §Sync Cursor]
- [x] CHK003 Are run-history requirements complete enough to preserve each attempt's trigger, scope, result, failure reason, partial reason, and cursor effect? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Data Model §Sync Run]
- [x] CHK004 Are lifecycle control requirements complete enough to separate aggregate cursor/backoff/counter state from individual run history? [Completeness, Spec FR-011, Spec FR-012, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control]
- [x] CHK005 Are bounded pagination requirements defined for page count, issue count, and elapsed duration? [Completeness, Spec FR-016, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK006 Are durable partial-run fields specified for reason, consumed pages, issue counts, duration, diagnostics, and reviewer-visible summary state? [Completeness, Spec FR-017, Data Model §Sync Run, Data Model §Partial Run State]
- [x] CHK007 Are owner-selection requirements complete enough to group candidates by `(workspace_id, github_repo)` before any automatic poll starts? [Completeness, Spec FR-031, Data Model §Repository Sync Scope]
- [x] CHK008 Are shared-repository duplicate-prevention requirements defined for single-project, single-owner, non-owner, and unresolved-owner cases? [Completeness, Spec FR-032, Spec FR-033, Data Model §Sync Ownership Decision]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is the cursor format clear enough for GitHub issue resume semantics and future compatible cursor formats? [Clarity, Data Model §Sync Cursor]
- [x] CHK010 Are partial-run reasons enumerated so implementers can distinguish page, issue, duration, rate-limit, and disablement bounds? [Clarity, Data Model §Partial Run State]
- [x] CHK011 Are cursor effect rules clear for failed, skipped, overlap, unresolved, stale-recovered, partial, and successful results? [Clarity, Data Model §Sync Run]
- [x] CHK012 Are lifecycle control bounds and validation rules quantified for interval, max pages, max issues, max duration, enablement, and active leases? [Clarity, Data Model §Poller Lifecycle Control]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are cursor rules consistent across the spec, data model, API status envelope, and manual-sync fallback assumptions? [Consistency, Spec FR-014, Spec FR-015, Contract §GET /api/github/sync]
- [x] CHK014 Are owner-filtering requirements consistent with SPEC-006 sync-owner precedent and the explicit `FEATURE_AREA_LABEL_ROUTING` boundary? [Consistency, Spec FR-009, Spec FR-034, Plan §Evidence Map]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK017 Can failed-attempt cursor preservation be objectively verified at 100% coverage for automatic sync attempts? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-002]
- [x] CHK018 Can bounded partial-run durability be objectively verified for page, issue, and duration bounds? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-003]

- [x] CHK020 Can stale lease recovery be objectively verified without data repair while preserving prior cursor state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec SC-006]

## Schema, Index, And Rollback Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Is the lifecycle schema specified as additive and isolated from destructive changes to existing GitHub sync history? [Coverage, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK022 Are unique and lookup indexes specified for control scope, due controls, stale leases, run scope history, linked compatibility sync rows, and run result queries? [Coverage, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK023 Are migration idempotence expectations specified for repeated M77 execution, unique scope enforcement, index existence, rollback, and rerun after rollback? [Coverage, Plan §Migration Plan]
- [x] CHK024 Is rollback SQL required and scoped so automatic lifecycle tables and indexes can be removed while manual sync history remains readable? [Coverage, Spec FR-021, Plan §Migration Plan]
